source: User confirmation in the active task, relayed by the coordinating agent on 2026-09-09; no external source is claimed to independently establish the emergency-hire trigger.
implementation_boundaries: Apply after the actual observed offer is validated, the displayed price is paid, and the hire transaction is committed exactly once.
Entering the node, observing candidates, refreshing offers, failed transactions, and replaying an expired or already consumed offer do not grow corn.
Emergency operators remain in the emergency roster; do not create formal operators, recruit tickets, or additional hires from this rule.
No automatic employment identity distribution or free three-operator outcome is inferred; observed candidate identities and displayed prices are still required.
The existing emergency deployment, departure, and formal-operation restrictions remain in force.
